title: Large personal MSX, Apple II Forth and Amiga discovery
summary: Personally screen 377 candidate URLs and add 31 source-backed projects, with two empty or README-only exclusions.
notes: Root assistant performed all research and publication without a worker, PR or new branch. Five fresh searches covered MSX, PC-98, Apple II, Amiga and Atari ST. Fork metadata was checked and already represented parent lineages skipped. Hardware-only leads were not selected for this software-focused batch. Each promoted root has primary documentation and implementation evidence; game disassembly metrics and byte-exact claims remain upstream claims, not independently reproduced semantics. Large recovered Forth blocks and repeated tracer copies are linked at immutable revisions rather than embedded repeatedly. No upstream software, ROM, disk, firmware, device command or network service was executed. MintPRINT explicitly credits Claude; no AI inference from CLAUDE.md presence alone. A meaningful SCSI Toolbox derivative is distinguished from its already tracked upstream. No native CPU is inferred solely from a platform label.

Decodes AHX headers, subsongs, positions, tracks and instruments into readable text.
